Scenario: Imagine we have a dataset of different countries. For each country, we have information on GDP, education level, access to clean water, and vaccination rates. We also have the average life expectancy for each country.
Goal: For a new country (or a region within a country) with known GDP, education level, access to clean water, and vaccination rates, we want to predict the life expectancy (Continuous or Discrete).
